note: External media coverage of the July-August 2026 R-LNG shortfall. Gathered by web search on 2026-09-05 and stored here rather than typed into a component, so every entry carries its outlet, URL and the basis for the day it sits on. These are REPORTING, not measurements: nothing here is plotted, summed or compared with an archive figure. `reportsOn` is the date the item is about, established from the item's own text or its URL, and `dateBasis` says which. Where neither established a date the item is listed with reportsOn null and shown outside the day-by-day timeline.
method: WebSearch, queries on the Moheshkhali/Excelerate FSRU outage, the August restart, and the Summit terminal halt.
